 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Extract the 1-filled rectangular board. External colored markers indicate
    # where markers of matching colors are positioned on that board.
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
    out=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    # Shift positions of each color's outside marker to the corresponding
    # in-board colored marker position; retain board pattern and add key colors
    # at the coordinates of the outside markers relative to board.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,1)):
        outside=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color and not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)]
        inside=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if grid[r][c]==color]
        for (r,c) in outside:
            # Outside markers map to the board edge-relative location, apparent
            # demos encode marker locations in transformed board.
            rr,cc=r-r0,c-c0
            if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]): out[rr][cc]=color
    return out
"
}

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)
    # transpose the framed canvas
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    out=[[grid[r0+r][c0+c] for r in range(r0,r1+1)] for c in range(c0,c1+1)]
    markers={}
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v not in (0,1) and not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1): markers.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    # Outside markers form a three-color L; render its shape in the transposed board,
    # anchored at the appropriate corners according to the L's orientation.
    if len(markers)>=3:
        # The three colors correspond to the three L vertices, with the corner
        # (degree-two vertex) mapped to the matching board corner.
        pts=[(v,p[0]) for v,p in markers.items()]
        # pairwise distances identify the right-angle vertex
        best=None
        for a in pts:
            for b in pts:
                for d in pts:
                    if len({a[0],b[0],d[0]})<3: continue
                    va,pa=a; vb,pb=b; vd,pd=d
                    dot=(pa[0]-pd[0])*(pb[0]-pd[0])+(pa[1]-pd[1])*(pb[1]-pd[1])
                    if dot==0:
                        best=(a,b,d); break
                if best: break
            if best: break
        if best:
            corner,arm1,arm2=best
            # L marker geometry determines grid corner and signed axes.
            cp=corner[1]; p1=arm1[1]; p2=arm2[1]
            # Select board corner with same inward directions after axis swap.
            top= (p1[0]-cp[0])>0 or (p2[0]-cp[0])>0
            left= (p1[1]-cp[1])>0 or (p2[1]-cp[1])>0
            # safer: corner lies at intersection of extreme marker coordinates;
            # map relative directions into output's row/column axes.
            dr=1 if ((p1[0]-cp[0]) or (p2[0]-cp[0]))>0 else -1
            dc=1 if ((p1[1]-cp[1]) or (p2[1]-cp[1]))>0 else -1
            rr=0 if dr>0 else h-1
            cc=0 if dc>0 else w-1
            out[cc][rr]=corner[0]
            # arms: external vertical maps output horizontal, horizontal maps vertical
            for v,p in (arm1,arm2):
                if p[0]!=cp[0]: out[cc][(rr+(w-1 if p[0]>cp[0] else -(w-1)))%h]=v
                else: out[(cc+(h-1 if p[1]>cp[1] else -(h-1)))%w][rr]=v
    return out
"
}
